sast.rationale: Code findings below HIGH are reviewed in the pull request, not blocked.

sca.rationale: Known vulnerable dependencies at HIGH or above block; lower ones are tracked.

secrets.rationale: Any detected secret blocks: a leaked credential has no acceptable severity.

container.rationale: Same threshold as dependencies: the image is a dependency set.

iac.rationale: Misconfigurations at HIGH or above expose data or access.

dast.rationale: DAST findings are observed on the running service, so MEDIUM already blocks.

detection.rationale: Normal traffic must raise no alert; any alert on the normal log is a false positive or a contract breach.
